css: body { margin: 0px; background: var(--cream); color: var(--dark); font: 15px / 1.65 "DM Sans", Arial, sans-serif; }
button, input, select, textarea { font: inherit; }
button, a, input, select, textarea { outline-offset: 5px; }
h1, h2 { font-family: "Playfair Display", Georgia, serif; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -1.8px; line-height: 1.12; }
.top { background: var(--wine); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 9px 5%; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
header { height: 100px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0px 5%; background: var(--cream); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(222, 215, 206); }
nav { display: flex; gap: 30px; align-items: center; font-size: 13px; }

.button { background: var(--wine); color: white; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 35px; padding: 16px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--wine); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }
.actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; margin-top: 32px; }
.hero-image { position: relative; overflow: hidden; min-height: 600px; background: rgb(111, 100, 87); }
.hero-image > img { height: 100%; width: 100%; position: absolute; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; }
.hero-image::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0px; background: linear-gradient(transparent 35%, rgba(39, 27, 26, 0.8)); }
.photo-note { position: absolute; bottom: 40px; left: 40px; z-index: 1; color: white; }
.photo-note strong { font: 38px / 1.15 "Playfair Display", Georgia, serif; display: block; margin-top: 15px; }

.seal { position: absolute; right: 25px; top: 25px; border: 1px solid rgb(234, 215, 172); border-radius: 50%; height: 90px; width: 90px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-direction: column; background: rgba(100, 28, 46, 0.88); color: rgb(241, 221, 185); font-family: Georgia; font-size: 25px; }
.ribbon { background: rgb(238, 233, 223); display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); padding: 30px 5%; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(221, 213, 200); }
.section-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 50px; align-items: flex-end; margin-bottom: 35px; }
.filterbar { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(217, 207, 193); margin: 20px 0px 30px; gap: 20px; }

.filters button { background: none; border-width: 0px 0px 2px; border-style: none none solid; border-color: currentcolor currentcolor transparent; border-image: none; padding: 15px 0px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; }
.card { background: rgb(255, 252, 246); border: 1px solid rgb(226, 219, 208); padding: 28px; position: relative; min-height: 260px; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; }
.card .card-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; color: var(--wine); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 1.3px; margin-bottom: 30px; }
.card h3 { font: 25px / 1.25 "Playfair Display", Georgia, serif; max-width: 260px; }
.card a { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }
.experience { background: var(--wine); color: rgb(255, 246, 232); padding: 90px 7%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 100px; }
.reasons article { display: flex; gap: 25px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(150, 97, 109); padding: 23px 0px; }
.reasons article > span { color: rgb(201, 167, 123); font-family: Georgia; font-size: 23px; }
.steps { text-align: left; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 40px; margin-top: 50px; }
.student { background: rgb(234, 228, 216); padding: 65px 7%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 60px; }
.student-links a { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 20px 0px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(207, 193, 175); font-size: 15px; }
details p { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); padding-top: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; }
.enquire { margin: 0px 5% 80px; padding: 65px 6%; background: rgb(238, 229, 216); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 80px; }
.enquire > div > p:not(.eyebrow) { color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; max-width: 320px; }
form label { display: block; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-weight: 600; }
form label span { font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted); }

form input, form select, textarea { display: block; width: 100%; border-width: 0px 0px 1px; border-style: none none solid; border-color: currentcolor currentcolor rgb(185, 170, 153); border-image: none; border-radius: 0px; padding: 12px 0px; background: transparent; color: var(--dark); font-size: 13px; }
footer { background: rgb(41, 27, 32); color: rgb(230, 218, 215); padding: 50px 6% 25px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 30px; }
.footer-brand span { display: block; font: 10px Arial; letter-spacing: 7px; }
footer p, footer a { font-size: 12px; color: rgb(191, 176, 179); }
footer small { grid-column: 1 / -1; border-top: 1px solid rgb(82, 62, 69); padding-top: 20px; font-size: 10px; color: rgb(191, 176, 179); }

Before you

How do I choose the right programme?

Tell our admissions team your highest qualification, subject interests and career goals. They can explain the available routes and entry requirements.

Can I study while working?

Study modes and class schedules vary by programme. Ask for the current timetable and attendance requirements before registering.

How do I check recognition and awarding details?

Request the exact qualification title, awarding institution, applicable recognition documentation and progression conditions for your selected programme.

Where can I get the latest fees and intake dates?

Contact admissions using the enquiry form below. The team can provide current fees, payment options and the next available intake.
